profile.headline: Stellar Services
profile.summary:
An avid learner with a technical background in Python, Java, and JavaScript. Enthusiastic about data science and its applications to different domains. Experience in using supervised and unsupervised learning models for solving various problems in the domain of natural language processing. Worked on projects involving building real-time chatbots, deploying an application on Cloud, and other online social networks.

The topic of my masters thesis at Clarkson University was "A Glass Bead level approach to retro reflectivity for pavement marking using RCNN" in which I designed a model to classify glass bead as present and not present in pavement marking.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
A part of the full SDLC team to Design, develop, code, and test IoT based software systems.
Participated in the agile development of project timelines, implementing design specifications, deploying a Windmill Monitoring dashboard to IBM Cloud.
Recommended Continous Improvement to fetch live data from Cloudant using Ajax call (jQuery) through REST API.
Developed a dashboard for monitoring data of windmill. Displaying live data of windmill from another location to the dashboard.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science and Engineering with specialization in Cloud Based Applications

projects.title: Sentiment Analysis Model | Deep Learning
projects.description:
Build a Sentiment Model with 86% accuracy and 7000 reviews/second on the IMDB movie rating database using positive and negative reviews.
Modules: Pre-process data, Reduce neural noise, Analyzing Inefficiencies in Network and Reducing Noise by Strategically Reducing the Vocabulary

projects.title: Custom Object Simulation | 3d Graphics in WebGL
projects.description:
Created a 3d Object Simulation to see how your object or furniture will look in your surroundings. Rotate in x,y, and z-direction and change the color or texture of an object by a single click.
Modules: Orthographic or Perspective View, Rotate X, Y, and Z direction, Toggle Texture, etc.
